Description:
[h1]TOWER OF DOOM: CYBERCITY[/h1]

Fifty floors. The staircase spirals up the [b]outside[/b] of the tower - open air, a long drop on one side, the horde on the other, nothing to hide behind.

[b]And the rounds never stop.[/b] The instant a round's last zombie spawns, the next round is already coming. No break, no fanfare, no moment to breathe you didn't pay for.

[b]But this one you can win.[/b] At the top of the tower there is a way out - if you can survive one last wave.

[h2]CLIMB OR DIE[/h2]

Buy your way up, door by door. Every tenth floor is a rest stop you will have earned: no spawns, Pack-a-Punch, an upgrade terminal, an ammo crate, a teleporter home. Between them, the stairs belong to the dead.

The perks are up there too - [b]all 8 machines, scattered at random and reshuffling as you climb[/b]. No memorised route. Every run, you hunt them down again.

[h2]YOUR GUN IS YOUR BUILD[/h2]

No mystery box. No wallbuys. Draft one of four classes - [b]Skirmisher, Assault, Heavy, Slasher[/b] - and carry its weapon ladder from a starter gun to monsters like the Death Machine and a leviathan axe. Pack-a-Punch unlocks your next tier. Your gun grows because you did.

[b]Every fourth round the world freezes[/b] and you get fifteen seconds to pick one of two upgrade cards - damage, fire rate, life steal, luck and more. Kills, headshots, revives and doors fill a luck bar that decides how strong the deal is. Choose fast: the horde is mid-leap when time stops, and it finishes the leap.

[h2]THE TOWER FIGHTS BACK[/h2]

A Panzer drops in every fifth round, with his own soundtrack. Rogue Protector waves come every third. Reavers and hellhound packs join the hunt the higher you climb - and the zombies themselves only get faster. The music climbs with you: four tracks that hand off as you pass the rest floors.

[h2]ONE LAST WAVE[/h2]

Reach the crown and buy [b]EXTRACTION[/b]. The gate opens, and you run a forked, ambushed bridge to the floating citadel while everything the tower has left comes at you from both sides.

Then the doors seal behind you, and you hold the hall against the final wave. [b]Survive it and you escape. Don't, and the tower keeps you.[/b]

Solo or co-op. Found a bug? Leave a comment and I'll fix it. Enjoy the climb.
